posts.body_html:
Second purchase from Mike. After having a little more exposure with Sarracenia, I had a different idea for what I wanted to get. Last time I purchased from Mike, he told me he'd have a plant I was looking for around November. I decided to contact him to see what the status was. He had a small division available. Done deal. He had virtually everything I was hoping to purchase and actually directed me to some other options that were even better.

His customer service is just impressive. If he doesn't have what you want at that moment, he offers something that is similar or better. He worked with me this time and I greatly appreciated that.

Shipping was next day after payment. I received my plants within 3 days. The quality and care is something else. Very thorough and careful with how they were unpotted and cleaned before shipping. Solid, long roots even on the smallest plants. The clean organization and labelling was a nice touch. He gave me some amazing plants, some with a multitude of growth points that I honestly could've divided if I wanted to. He sent me an extra plant that is just vibrant. Honestly, it looks nicer than the plants I actually bought lol. I don't have the most sophisticated taste with Sarracenia but I've expanded my horizons just from the extra plants I've received.

Great customer service, amazing plants, insane variety and fast shipping. Mike is a legend. I don't even bother looking anywhere else now.
